value.rationale: Provides a robust, locally attracting counterexample to an explicit general-convergence conjecture in a new mathematically motivated public-goods/social-opinion model. Shows the phenomenon even on symmetric, aperiodic, complete networks; proves a sharp structural mixing bound and quantitative attraction, not a routine one-step special case.
